newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter, Morgan Stanley detail vote results.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter, Morgan Stanley detail vote results.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co and Morgan Stanley Group Inc said Wednesday that shareholders in both companies overwhelmingly approved the merger of the two firms.
In a joint statement, Dean Witter said the merger was approved by 98 percent of votes cast by its shareholders. Morgan Stanley said 99 percent of votes cast were in favor.

Dean Witter said the merger was approved by holders representing about 87 percent of its outstanding common shares. Morgan Stanley said holders representing about 83 percent of shares entitled to vote approved the deal.
The companies announced preliminary approvals at separate shareholder meetings early this morning.
